title: Peritia
description: Peritia means "skill" in Latin. This is a library to implement passive skills into Minecraft.
body:
Peritia is a library mod for implementing passive skills, meaning that skills are leveled up by other actions such as breaking blocks, fishing, etc. The library is JSON driven, no Java code is required to add more content.

## 🛠️ Features 🛠️
- Passive Skills
- 15 different ways to level up skills
- Recipes unlocked by skills
- 4 new Attributes
- Enchantments related to skills
- A command to manage/view skills

## 🤔 Getting Started 🤔
### For Developers
Visit [this wiki](https://github.com/poscard8/peritia/wiki) I made.  If you have issues/requests/contributions please contact me.

### For Players
Using `/peritia help` in game will give you a brief overview.

Most features of Peritia can be configured by client or server configs. You can view these files manually or running `/config showfile peritia CLIENT` or `/config showfile peritia SERVER` in game.

## 🧩 Compatible Mods 🧩
- JEI
- Jade
